Fateful Tales of Indians in America : Shiekh Kaesar & Sakharam Ganesh Pandit
In 1785, an American ship named "The Pallas" brought tea, silk, opium, and cinnamon from Asia to America, carrying 35 Indian sailors, or "Lascars," including their leader, Shaikh Caisar aka Sick Keesar.
The Sailors were promised passage from China to Indonesia but were forcibly taken to Baltimore (USA) at gunpoint, where they were doomed to wait for justice.
